summary: CLI iterations drive the compiled main control flow and the CSR terminal offset equals n=floor(dim²/sparsity). Width is selected among 2/4/8/16/32 by average nnz, with spmvLongRows selected for average>=2048. Short-row launch computes ceil(numRows/(128/width)) blocks, capped at 16*SMs; its warp-based grid-stride loop covers all rows and each subgroup traverses its full CSR interval by width before lane 0 stores. Long rows use a capped grid and explicit row grid-stride loop; each row’s nonzeros are accumulated by 128 threads, reduced and stored. For iterations>=32, a graph is captured with batchSize=min(iterations,256); otherwise the timed remainder uses direct launch calls. Compiled host at b6cb records start, b700 launches each graph and b71b decrements by batch size with the b721 backedge; b730 handles the remaining direct launches before b75f records stop and b773 synchronizes. The launch lambda and all native wrapper stubs for five widths plus longRows were followed to cudaLaunchKernel. All six final sm86 kernels were inspected through row/nonzero bounds, arithmetic loop backedges, reductions, stores and exits. No omission identified.
